semiconductor_relevance: High — 3D-Micromac AG specializes in laser micromachining systems that are critical for high-precision applications in semiconductor manufacturing.
summary: 3D-Micromac AG is a leading provider of laser solutions tailored for semiconductor manufacturing, focusing on high-precision processes such as Ohmic Contact Formation and selective laser annealing. Their innovative systems enhance efficiency and reliability in semiconductor labs, particularly for sample preparation and failure analysis.
capabilities: Laser micromachining systems for semiconductor manufacturing
Selective laser annealing for SiC power devices
Femtosecond laser systems for non-destructive sample preparation
Laser link trimming and magnet sensor pinning processes

regional_presence.Germany: Headquartered in Chemnitz, Germany, 3D-Micromac combines advanced laser technology with strong global customer support.
